intro: Join Indian Navy has Released INET 02/2026 Official Notification for Online Application form for the Post of  Navy Agniveer Apprentice 01/2027 & 02/2027 Batch for Unmarried Male Candidates. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to Navy Agniveer Apprentice. Online Apply Start On June 5, 2026 & Last Date for Application is June 29, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.

Agniveer (Apprentice) 01/2027 Batch: Candidate should be born between 01 December 2004 – 31 May 2009 (Both dates inclusive)
Agniveer (Apprentice) 02/2027 Batch: Candidate should be born between 01 May 2005 – 31 October 2009 (Both dates inclusive).
Read the Notification for Age Relaxation.

Candidates must have passed Matriculation Examination
																with minimum 50% marks in aggregate from the Boards of School Education recognised by Ministry of Education, Govt. of India and completed 03 Years diploma course from All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) recognised Polytechnic Institute with 50% marks in aggregate in any of the following diploma courses:-

Engineering: - Marine Engineering & Systems, Mechanical, Production/ Automobile, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning, Repair and Maintenance, Power Plant Engineering, Industrial/Production, Maintenance, Machine, Manufacturing/ Manufacturing Technology,
																Mechatronics, Metallurgy, Instrumentation, Electronics Instrumentation and Control Engineering.
Electrical:- Electrical, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation Technology, Electronics, Electrical and Electronics, Electronics Instrumentation and Control Engineering.
Pay Scale:- As Per Rule.
Mode of Selection:-

Stage I: Indian Navy Entrance Test (INET)
																

																
																
																	Computer-Based Exam: Candidates first appear for the INET, which tests subject-specific knowledge along with general aptitude.
																	State-Wise Shortlisting: Based on the marks obtained in the exam, candidates are shortlisted for the next phase. Cut-off marks are determined on a state-by-state basis
																
																

																
																Stage II: Assessment and Medicals
																Shortlisted candidates are called to a designated naval center (such as INS Chilka) for the following evaluations
																

																
																
																	Physical Fitness Test (PFT): Mandatory physical standards require a 1.6 KM run, squats (uthak baithak), push-ups, and bent knee sit-ups.
																	Written Examination: A secondary written test designed specifically for Stage II.
																	Recruitment Medical Examination: Comprehensive medical and visual standards tests are conducted by military doctors.
																
																

																
																Final Selection
																

																
																
																	A final state-wise merit list is formulated after the Stage II tests.
																	The selected individuals then undergo final medical formalities before enrollment.
